name: Battery Chamberlin
note: districts/batteries.ts: 1904, Baker Beach: the disappearing gun's pit in its parapet, magazines, the earth berm. Was a 12 m presidio-style barracks.

name: Battery Crosby
note: districts/batteries.ts: 1900, on the bluff over Baker Beach. Was a 12 m presidio-style barracks.

name: Battery Godfrey
note: districts/batteries.ts: 1896, the first of the Endicott batteries, by the Golden Gate. Was a 12 m presidio-style barracks.

name: Battery Boutelle
note: districts/batteries.ts: 1900, beside Godfrey (batteryCrosby's model). Was a 12 m presidio-style barracks.

name: Battery Cranston
note: districts/batteries.ts: 1897, beside Godfrey (batteryGodfrey's model). Was a 12 m presidio-style barracks.
